notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics platform) building in-app conversational assistant + semantic search for support and product tours. Started with Hosted API to evaluate latency/cost; engineering happy with p50 for chat on hosted but product needs deterministic p95 for user-facing flows. Team wants Dedicated (VPC) for production to meet compliance and predictable throughput.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "We need SSO + audit trails for any model calls tied to user IDs." — Director Platform (11/12)
- "If Dedicated gets us predictable latency and ability to control keys, we move forward." — Head of Product (11/28)

Technical requirements (PRIORITY):
- Deployment: VPC peering or private egress to Dedicated hosts; optional private control plane is ideal.
- Auth: SSO via SAML (Okta), token scoping for service accounts, short-lived tokens for runtime calls.
- Crypto: Customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest of caches and logs.
- Audit: Per-request audit logs with a one-year retention (searchable) and delivery to customer's logging endpoint (syslog/CloudWatch).
- Data residency: Primary in US, EU for EMEA customers — need confirmation of region placement for Dedicated nodes.
- Retention controls: configurable retention policy for KV/prefix cache and request logs; ability to purge on demand.

POC scope and metrics:
- POC target: 6-week eval running on Dedicated pool (dev/stage) with mirrored traffic for embeddings and chat reranking.
- Throughput target: sustained ~200–400 qps for embedding lookups; burst to 1k qps acceptable with autoscale.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms for embeddings, p95 < 500ms for chat responses (with batching allowances).
- Cost sensitivity: medium — product team expects savings over hosted at >500k reqs/mo but is OK with premium during POC.

Procurement & legal: DPA needs two minor redlines (deletion window, subprocessor list). Finance requested a rough committed-capacity price matrix (monthly tiers).

- Timberline: schedule infra walkthrough (target Dec 6), provide firewall egress IPs, and share security questionnaire answers by Dec 9.
